### 1. POSSIBLE CONDITION
Possible Condition: Your stomach pain may be related to indigestion, acid reflux, or a minor stomach infection.

### 2. SEVERITY LEVEL
Mild

### 3. SUGGESTED MEDICINES
Medicine: Antacid (e.g., Tums, Rolaids)
Used for: Neutralizing stomach acid and relieving heartburn and indigestion.

Medicine: Ginger (e.g., ginger ale, ginger tea)
Used for: Soothing the stomach and reducing inflammation.

### 4. QUICK CARE TIPS
✓ Eat light meals and avoid fatty or spicy foods
✓ Drink plenty of water to stay hydrated
✓ Avoid lying down after eating
✓ Consider over-the-counter ginger or antacid products

### 5. DOCTOR VISIT INDICATOR
N/A

### 6. EMERGENCY ALERT
N/A
